name: Public review reply desk
why: Replies to each new batch of reviews and holds the risky ones, matching the review steps in the customer messages skill.

name: Review reply batch writer
why: A one-off version of the review reply prompt, with risky reviews flagged for the owner.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Checks a complaint reply for promises the owner has not approved before it gets the owner's yes.

name: Prepare a construction variation decision
why: Checks a change against the signed scope and prices, like the change-note step in the quote skill, for larger building jobs.

name: Prepare a client scope change brief
why: Sets out options and a reply when a customer asks for work outside the quoted scope.

name: Client scope decision review assistant
why: Keeps requested extras marked as proposed until the customer accepts, the same rule as the change note.

name: Check capacity before promising a delivery date
why: Checks the team's real hours before a start date is promised, like step 2 of the scheduling skill.

name: Explain appointment no show patterns
why: Finds which days, times or job types get missed, to tune reminders and booking rules.

name: Property maintenance evidence review assistant
why: Turns open repair tickets and access notes into a handover, useful for trades serving landlords and property managers.

name: Weekly invoice and cash chaser
why: Finds late payers each week and drafts reminders for the owner to approve, the step after a job is invoiced.

name: Post-sale follow-up planner
why: A thank-you and contact schedule after a job, a starting point for maintenance plan and repeat-visit reminders.
